title: Graph Cascades: Contagion-Based Mesoscopic Rewiring for Structure-Aware Graph Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.05046v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce Graph Cascades, a mesoscopic rewiring strategy for Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Graph Transformers (GTs) that captures intermediate-scale graph structure beyond purely local edges or fully global attention. Using contagion-based diffusion with fixed cascade parameters, Graph Cascades constructs, in O(|V|+|E|) time, a sparse auxiliary graph where node pairs supported by repeated multi-hop reinforcement are promoted to direct neighbors. translated_title: Graph Cascades：基于传染扩散的介观重连方法，用于结构感知的图机器学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Graph Cascades，这是一种面向图神经网络（GNN）和图Transformer（GT）的介观重连策略，能够捕获超越纯局部边或完全全局注意力的中间尺度图结构。Graph Cascades使用具有固定级联参数的基于传染（contagion）的扩散过程，在O(|V|+|E|)时间内构建一个稀疏辅助图，其中受到重复多跳强化（reinforcement）支持的节点对被提升为直接邻居。我们从理论上刻画了基于强化的重连何时有效：给出了基于强化的边选择比直接邻接更具标签一致性的充分条件；提供了一个随机块模型（SBM）实例，其中两跳强化是完全同配的；并通过图有效电阻对介观连通性进行了形式化。实证结果表明，在多个节点分类基准上，Graph Cascades改进了多种GNN和稀疏图Transformer骨干网络，其中最可靠的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Graph Cascades提出了一种基于传染扩散的介观图重连策略，在线性时间内将受多跳强化支持的节点对提升为直接邻居，并从理论（标签一致性条件、SBM同配性、有效电阻刻画）和实验上证明其能提升多种GNN与稀疏图Transformer在节点分类任务上的性能。
en_tdlr: Graph Cascades is a contagion-based mesoscopic rewiring method that promotes multi-hop reinforced node pairs to direct neighbors in O(|V|+|E|) time, providing theoretical guarantees (label alignment, SBM homophily, effective resistance) and empirical improvements for GNNs and sparse Graph Transformers on node classification.
